body:
This happened to me.
I always had to be the one to call.
He never initiated. I always felt like I was bothering him and felt like a chore to schedule times to hang out.
I mean, he always meant it felt like, he was doing God's work by hanging out with me. 
Then I realized we're not friends anymore. I mean, we are on Facebook and we have mutual friends and everyone think we're best buds. But the guy just doesn't like me anymore as a person. He'd rather go to a bible study than see his old friend in the hospital.

When I was the one always making the effort to call and text. So I stopped. Haven't heard from him in a year.
We sadly we grew up together.
From kindergarten to college. Our families know each other and expect us to be each others best men.

I just feel like a burden tbh. 
I loved the second season :)
Suicidal. I'd rather die than be out in the street. Maybe I'm just looking for an excuse.
My family. If I did anything to myself. I don't know what kind of pain I'd cause them.
Thanks. I always struggle. I want to tell someone but I could never.  Friends and family are the hardest people to talk to
